FULL TEXT:
ADVERTISEMENT
GUEST FACULTY REQUIRED IN ICSVS
No. of Position:1
Interview on 11.11.2024 at 11:30 a.m ICSVS for the appointment of Guest Faculty
to teach certificate courses at the Interdisciplinary Centre for Swami Vivekananda
Studies, (ICSVS) Panjab University Chandigarh for the Session (June-
December)2024-25.
Name of Post: (1) Assistant Professor in Philosophy/
Indian Philosophy
Essentials: M.A.in Philosophy/Indian Philosophy
Desirable: Ph.D. in Indian Philosophy/UGC NET /JRF in
Philosophy
Last Date for Application Submission: 06.11.2024.
All the applicants are advised to bring their original certificate and other relevant
documents for verification along with the duly filled form giving the following details
at the time of
interview:
1. Name
2. Date of birth
3. Educational Qualification (with percentage from 10th onward Attached
self- attested Photocopies)
4. Attested photocopy of Degree M.A./ Ph.D.
5. Teaching Experience (attach details)
6. Any other relevant documents like Projects completed (self-attested)
7. Publications etc.
8. Correspondence Address
9. Contact No./ Mobile No.
10. E-mail ID
The above assignment is on lecture basis with a token honorarium of Rs. 1500/- per
lecture with an upper limit of Rs. 50,000/- per month
Note: No TA/DA will be paid for the interview.
(Prof. Shivani Sharma)
Coordinator, ICSVS
